root_cause: The 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step runs two Expand-Archive PowerShell commands on a Windows runner via GitHub Actions' auto-generated temp .ps1 wrapper script. The runner's PowerShell execution policy (Restricted) blocks loading any .ps1 file (PSSecurityException / UnauthorizedAccess), even though the commands themselves are benign Expand-Archive calls. This is a Windows-runner image/environment misconfiguration unrelated to the PR's code changes (PR #39839 only touches GPU plugin CPU-impl event-generation logic and a unit test, neither of which affects the Windows VS2022 job's execution policy). This is the 3rd occurrence of the identical signature within ~17 hours, confirming a recurring runner-pool provisioning defect rather than an isolated incident.
reproduction_steps: N/A - this is a Windows-runner image/environment issue (PowerShell execution policy) triggered non-deterministically depending on the specific self-hosted/ephemeral runner instance assigned to the job; it does not reproduce locally or depend on the PR diff.
recommended_actions: Ensure the Windows runner image / bootstrap sets PowerShell execution policy to RemoteSigned or Bypass for the actions-runner service account (e.g., via `Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process` in the runner setup, or a machine/user GPO) so GitHub Actions' auto-generated .ps1 wrapper scripts can be loaded.

Alternatively, have the 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step invoke PowerShell explicitly with `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` (e.g. `shell: pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "..."`) instead of relying on the default shell wrapper.

Audit the Windows GPU runner pool/image provisioning scripts urgently: this is now the 3rd occurrence in 17 hours, indicating either a bad image rollout or a subset of misconfigured runner instances still in rotation.
prevention_strategies: Bake execution-policy configuration into the Windows runner image provisioning (Packer/Ansible/etc.) and add a post-provisioning smoke test that runs a trivial Expand-Archive PowerShell step to catch regressions before the image is promoted to production use. Consider quarantining/draining runner instances that fail this check.
historical_context: Identical signature previously observed on 2026-11-16 (run 43897852421, PR #39833) and 2026-11-17 (run 44051380184, PR #39423), both on the 'GPU unit tests' job's 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step. This is the 3rd occurrence recorded in the CI Doctor MQ pattern database (pattern c351b86e95419730), crossing the 3-occurrences/12-hour recurring-escalation threshold (all three occurred between 2026-11-16T17:32:33Z and 2026-11-17T10:59:00Z, well within a 17.5-hour span, with 2 of the 3 within the last 12 hours — not quite 3-within-12h, see Phase 5.5 calculation). A human-review PR (#39951) proposing the rerun search string 'scripts is disabled on this system' for this exact signature was already opened and remains open/unmerged as of this run.
